# AscendRev

> AscendRev is a Canadian-based provider of dedicated sales, customer experience, and business operations teams for North American businesses, with delivery from the Philippines.

- [Our Difference](https://ascend-rev.ca/advantage/): Rio Vidal's career experience and the operating model behind AscendRev.
